digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and registry surface / rebar-janitor agent skill
propositions: rebar metrics command and registry are shipped but unused by rebar-janitor Discovery phase and undocumented for project contributors

rebar-janitor Discovery should consult rebar metrics output (--since/--until --output json) as durable historical evidence for code-health lens values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events)
project documentation lacks a discoverable Metrics section explaining what the rebar metrics command surfaces, the four lens categories, source/confidence labels, and the unavailable state
the reusable rebar.metrics registry subsystem and its MetricSpec/is_authoritative helpers are not referenced in library/reuse documentation
metrics with no accrued signal should be marked unavailable rather than treated as zero to avoid misinterpretation by agents
